name: – Pasquale Tridico – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text:
The European Parliament refuses to approve how the Council spent its 2024 budget. It says the Council has refused for years to answer Parliament's questions and take part in the yearly budget checks that every other European Union institution goes through. Parliament wants the Council to resume talks and agree a binding arrangement, to split its budget clearly between the European Council and the Council, and to be open about its spending on computers, security and outside advisers.

- Parliament withholds approval of the Council's 2024 spending, as it has since 2009.
- It affects the Council and its Secretary-General, who must answer Parliament's questions.
- Next: the Council is asked to restart talks at the highest level to end the deadlock.
